RESPONDENT/COMPLAINANT(S)
Others Counsel for the Petitioner/accused:

1. K JYOTHI PRASAD Counsel for the Respondent/complainant(S):
 1. PUBLIC PROSECUTOR

The Court made the following:
 THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE HARINATH.N  CRIMINAL PETITION No.3834 OF 2025 ORDER:
1.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was arraigned as A.1 in S.C.
No.109 of 2024 on the file of the VII Additional District & Sessions Judge, Visakhapatnam,
registered for the alleged offences under Sections 417, 420, 376 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.
2. The learned counsel, after arguing the matter for some time, seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the criminal petition.
4. Accordingly, the criminal petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
5. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
